headline: Rising Construction Costs Drive Turkish Hotel Investors Toward Existing Assets
summary: Higher building expenses and limited land availability in Turkey have shifted hospitality sector investment toward acquiring existing properties rather than developing new real estate.
why: Tourism and commercial real estate are key source industries for foreign exchange and fixed capital formation in Turkey.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: High replacement costs shift dealflow to corporate mergers and asset acquisitions over greenfield building.
